# GUI Interface Description

## 1. **Operating System Environment**
   - **Desktop Environment**: Ubuntu-based Linux distribution with GNOME desktop environment.
   - **Wallpaper**: Abstract purple and pink geometric design.
   - **Top Panel**:
     - **Left Side**: 
       - "Activities" button for accessing the application overview.
       - "Thunderbird Mail" application name is displayed.
     - **Right Side**:
       - Date and time: "Mar 22 17:18".
       - System tray icons:
         - Notification bell icon.
         - User menu icon.
         - Power menu icon.

## 2. **Notification**
   - **Position**: Top-center of the screen.
   - **Content**:
     - Title: "Software Updates Available to Download".
     - Message: "Please download waiting software updates."
     - Icon: Information icon (circle with an "i").

## 3. **Application Window**
   - **Application**: Thunderbird Mail (Email client).
   - **Window Title**: "Write: New-month AWS Bill - Thunderbird".
   - **Window Layout**:
     - **Menu Bar**:
       - Options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help.
     - **Toolbar**:
       - Buttons: 
         - "Send".
         - "Encrypt".
         - "Spelling".
         - "Save".
         - "Contacts".
         - "Attach".
     - **Email Fields**:
       - **From**: "Mathias Gadenzi <mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com>".
       - **To**: "assistant@outlook.com".
       - **Cc** and **Bcc** fields are visible but empty.
       - **Subject**: "New-month AWS Bill".
     - **Formatting Toolbar**:
       - Dropdowns and buttons for text formatting:
         - Paragraph style dropdown.
         - Font dropdown.
         - Font size dropdown.
         - Bold, Italic, Underline, and Strikethrough buttons.
         - Text alignment buttons.
         - List formatting buttons (bulleted and numbered lists).
         - Indentation buttons.
         - Text color and background color buttons.
         - Emoji button.
     - **Email Body**:
       - Large blank text area for composing the email.

## 4. **Dock (Left Sidebar)**
   - **Position**: Left side of the screen.
   - **Icons** (from top to bottom):
     - Firefox (web browser).
     - Thunderbird Mail (email client, currently active).
     - Visual Studio Code (code editor).
     - LibreOffice Calc (spreadsheet application).
     - LibreOffice Writer (word processor).
     - VLC Media Player.
     - GIMP (image editor).
     - File Manager.
     - Ubuntu Software Center.
     - Help.
     - Trash (recycle bin).

## 5. **Desktop Icons**
   - **Position**: Bottom-right corner.
   - **Icons**:
     - "Home" folder icon.
